projects.name: Granbury, Texas data center
projects.quote: We believe our state-of-the-art 290 MW nameplate capacity data center in Granbury is one of the largest containerized liquid immersion-cooled sites worldwide.

projects.name: Kearney, Nebraska bitcoin mining site
projects.quote: ACQUISITIONS Granbury, TX and Kearney, NE:In January 2024, we acquired two operational bitcoin mining sites totaling 390 MW of nameplate capacity.

projects.name: Garden City, Texas bitcoin mining site
projects.quote: Garden City, TX:In April 2024, we acquired an operational bitcoin mining site with 132 megawatts of operational capacity and 200 MW of nameplate capacity.

projects.name: Hannibal and Hopedale, Ohio data centers
projects.quote: Hannibal, Hopedale, and Findlay, OH:In November 2024, we acquired two operational data centers with 222 MW of interconnect-approved capacity.

projects.name: Findlay, Ohio greenfield data center
projects.quote: In addition to the acquired data centers, we began developing a 150 MW greenfield operational data center in Findlay, Ohio.

projects.name: Hansford County, Texas wind farm
projects.quote: Hansford County, TX:In February 2025, we acquired a wind farm with 240 MW of interconnection capacity and 114 MW of nameplate wind capacity.
